systems.substitution_definition: Identical 3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups are bonded through their ipso carbon atoms to positions 6 and 12 of pentaleno[1,2-b:4,5-b']dibenzothiophene. All unspecified valences are satisfied by hydrogen. No stereogenic element is specified or required.

Identical 4-methoxyphenyl groups are bonded through their ipso carbon atoms to positions 6 and 12 of pentaleno[1,2-b:4,5-b']dibenzothiophene. Each methoxy group is para to the core attachment. All unspecified valences are satisfied by hydrogen. No stereogenic element is specified or required.

observable_definition.name: NICS_nn(h)
observable_definition.rings: The two monocyclic five-membered carbon rings that together form the central fused pentalene unit; exclude the sulfur-containing and six-membered benzenoid rings.
observable_definition.centroid: Arithmetic mean of the Cartesian coordinates of the five ring carbon nuclei.
observable_definition.mean_plane: Least-squares plane through all carbon nuclei of the fused pentalene unit.
observable_definition.probe_positions: For each of the two carbon-ring centroids use centroid + h*n in the declared molecular frame at every signed height.
observable_definition.reported_molecular_value: Retain ring-resolved values at every height and side; the +1.7 ring mean is an additional baseline observable.
observable_definition.sign_convention: NICSzz = - n^T sigma n in ppm, where sigma is the shielding tensor in the geometry coordinate frame and n is the declared unit plane normal. An aligned Cartesian z component is equivalent; an unaligned global zz is not.

model_boundary.endpoint: Validated relaxed minima and explicitly constrained common-core controls; do not call the controls unconstrained minima.

geometry_comparison.fixed_core_policy: Choose a common core or reciprocal core swaps and declare peripheral relaxation; record each constraint.
